answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in marble, checked in haven, and yarrow shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1363 identities would post 3937 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
